g.text: Class detail: context, services, helpers and step traits
Never calls getSession(), so it cannot
Entity cleanup lives with the concern that
creates entities. Every step trait that creates
one composes this, and trait flattening is
idempotent, so there is still one registry and
A step names a capability through driverFor()
and never a driver, so the vocabulary carries
over to a driver a project registers itself.
A helper trait composed by a step trait and by
the context under it holds one property slot,
so both reach the same state.
Applying credentials to a request needs Mink and
a base URL, so BasicAuthenticator is separate from
the Drupal session services and WebRawContext
A resolver depends on the context class that declared
the options and on the config argument that context was
given, so it is built per context rather than shared.
Registering another factory replaces option resolution
DriverListener fills ScenarioTagRegistry before the first
BeforeScenario hook, so a tag that sets an option reaches
a step as well as a hook.
